verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas ships several official, npm-published SDKs: the `playcanvas` engine package (runtime probe shows version 2.22.2), `@playcanvas/react`, `@playcanvas/web-components`, a documented scriptable Editor API, plus the `create-playcanvas` scaffolder with TypeScript starters. missing for 10: an official client SDK or OpenAPI spec for the plan-gated REST API (OpenAPI probe paths all returned 404).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `npm view playcanvas version` → 2.22.2 (MIT engine runtime, 48,435 weekly downloads). A scriptable Editor API is separately documented at api.playcanvas.com/editor/.
`@playcanvas/react` builds PlayCanvas Engine scenes declaratively from React components and hooks, with the full engine underneath.
`@playcanvas/web-components` builds PlayCanvas Engine scenes declaratively from custom HTML elements
The Editor module provides a comprehensive API for automating and extending the functionality of the PlayCanvas Editor.
Use `create-playcanvas` to scaffold a Vite and TypeScript project for the Engine, React, or Web Components from one of 12 runnable starters.
